description: Player touched the iron door, triggering the Seal of Acknowledgement. The door spoke three words in Old Velmoorian and one of three glyphs went dark, indicating a sequence with two attempts remaining.
outcome: Door partially activated. Sequence lock engaged. Two glyphs remain. Party alerted to limited attempts.

description: Rhea spoke the Old Velmoorian command phrase 'Evan-sol verath' clearly and deliberately before the iron door's remaining two glyphs.
outcome: Phrase accepted. Seal of Acknowledgement broken. Iron door unlocked. Passage to the north opened. Party may now advance.
